product.summary: A modular C11 workstation for read-only processor discovery, bounded measurements, source diagnostics, memory operations and local DSP.
proof_points: Native C11 core with Windows desktop and portable command-line surfaces.
Read-only discovery and bounded local measurement workflows.
Source diagnostics, memory utilities and local PCM/DSP operations.
non_claims: Benchmark results are not hardware certification or universal cross-device rankings.
The product does not silently change processor, firmware or operating-system settings.
Market demand, paid conversion and profitability are not established.

audiences.need: Inspect processor capabilities and compare bounded local measurements without opaque changes.
audiences.value: A transparent native workstation with traceable measurement context.

audiences.audience: IT labs, QA teams and technical educators
audiences.need: Create repeatable local diagnostics and explain machine-specific results.
audiences.value: A modular toolset with explicit limits and inspectable output.

audiences.audience: C/C++ tool builders and DSP experimenters
audiences.need: Explore reusable native utilities and local audio-processing operations.
audiences.value: A C11-oriented implementation with documented interfaces and bounded operations.

positioning.statement: Pytyliki is a read-only processor-systems workstation for transparent discovery, bounded measurement and local diagnostics.
differentiators: Native C11 implementation and portable CLI/Windows desktop surfaces.
Processor inventory, bounded tests, source diagnostics and local DSP in one modular workstation.

brand.promise: Make local processor-system inspection understandable, bounded and reproducible.

stages.name: Problem discovery
stages.success_criteria: Collect observed workflows from developers, lab operators and educators.

stages.name: Message and documentation
stages.success_criteria: README and market profile explain workflows, proof points and non-claims.

stages.name: Distribution
stages.success_criteria: Public source repository and documented build path remain reproducible.

stages.name: User validation
stages.success_criteria: Record dated feedback and repeat-use evidence from target users.

stages.name: Retention and support
stages.success_criteria: Publish support boundaries, issue triage and compatibility maintenance policy.

channels.name: GitHub repository and README
channels.purpose: Explain capabilities, build instructions, boundaries and release provenance.
channels.guardrail: Keep every claim linked to code, tests or documentation.

channels.name: Versioned release artifacts
channels.purpose: Provide a stable way to evaluate packaged builds when published.
channels.guardrail: Do not imply certification or compatibility beyond tested environments.

channels.name: Technical demonstrations and articles
channels.purpose: Show bounded measurements and diagnostic workflows with reproducible inputs.
channels.guardrail: Disclose hardware, OS, versions and test conditions.

channels.name: Developer and hardware communities
channels.purpose: Collect qualified workflow feedback and answer technical questions.
channels.guardrail: No spam, fake endorsements or claims based on anecdote.

market_validation.notes: No structured target-user research or adoption evidence is asserted.

pricing.notes: No price, paid tier or willingness-to-pay assumption is published.

unit_economics.notes: Development, packaging and support costs require measurement.

licensing.notes: Review project license and dependencies before redistribution or commercial packaging.

support.notes: Define supported platforms, issue intake and maintenance ownership.

distribution.notes: The public repository and build documentation are available; packaged release availability is release-specific.

metrics.name: First successful diagnostic workflow
metrics.definition: Share of evaluated users who complete a documented inventory or measurement task.
metrics.source: Consent-based feedback or an explicitly documented evaluation study.
metrics.privacy_note: Do not add hidden in-product tracking.

metrics.name: Release retrieval
metrics.definition: Downloads of published release assets, when present.
metrics.privacy_note: Downloads are not active use or proof of demand.

metrics.name: Support resolution
metrics.definition: Time from a scoped issue to a verified resolution.
metrics.source: Public issue timestamps and release notes.

governance.claims: State processor, OS and measurement conditions; do not claim universal accuracy, hardware certification or guaranteed performance gains.
governance.promotion: Use reproducible technical demonstrations and precise capability descriptions; separate implemented work from roadmap.
governance.privacy: Keep diagnostics local by default; do not introduce undisclosed telemetry or machine fingerprinting.
governance.rights: Review dependency licenses, logos and third-party assets before commercial distribution.
